programs.title: All Girls Garage
programs.desc: The forgotten mustang is back, and it's time to forget about the stock engine in the car  the All-Girls Garage team pulls out this leaky 302 to put an upgraded 302 engine in that was dyno tested at 305 horsepower.

programs.title: All Girls Garage
programs.desc: The women get the opportunity to work on some modified VW off-road Baja style buggies  they get right under the hood as these Beetles get made for the beach.

programs.desc: As Brad and Doug prepare to move, they take to social media for ideas for the ultimate UTV  they take their skills to new levels by Deberti-izing their Segways, making them more suitable for race-day conditions.
